description: This file defines data structures (TypedDict classes) used for integrating with PagerDuty and alerting configurations, including request payloads, alert thresholds, and internal event metadata.

classes.name: LinkDict
classes.description: TypedDict for link-related data, with optional href and text fields.

classes.name: ImageDict
classes.description: TypedDict for image-related data, including source URL, optional link, and alt text.

classes.name: PagerDutyPayload
classes.description: TypedDict capturing the details of a PagerDuty alert payload, including severity, source, and optional custom details.

classes.name: PagerDutyRequestBody
classes.description: TypedDict representing the structure of the request body sent to PagerDuty, including payload, routing key, event action, and optional links/images.

classes.name: AlertingConfig
classes.description: Configuration for alerting thresholds, including failure and hanging request limits and window durations.

classes.name: PagerDutyInternalEvent
classes.description: Structured metadata for internal events related to PagerDuty alerts, including timestamp, error info, and event type.
